runtimeMapping.ordinary: Single ground melee input; .5-second marker with native maxAnimScale1; separate Arts and Physical mitigation.
runtimeMapping.s1: On-locate duration20 and source ASPD. Per-victim counter; normal pairs at .4 marker. ThirdAttack Sequence retains input across pairs at .367/.633 and Skill_Attack4 .3. Cooldown at least two intervals. Local phase2 starts after the greater of interval or final phase1 marker.
runtimeMapping.s2: Born1s then retained START ground group,16 fixed Skill_2 events and3.433s tail. Native character rewrite scales Arts by talent*talent_scale, Physical by atk_scale. Taunt+1, immune stun/freeze/sleep, damageable.
runtimeMapping.s3: Invulnerable/no-block/control immune on-locate,1s born then independent moving collider8tiles/sec,.51radius,.2distance gate,.3extension per eligible collision,min2/max5 truncated to actual geometry edge. Ground+air. Arts scales by talent*atk_scale, Physical by atk_scale. .667s tail then return. Toggle gauge displays active without fabricated duration.
runtimeMapping.archdemon: Selected E2 multiplicative13%/potential5 16% ATK during skill and10s afterward; none E0/E1. Withdrawal/death cancels boost.
runtimeMapping.cleanup: Owned timers guard deployment/activation/control; marks, dash, custom stance and buffs clear on withdrawal/death; rebirth activates once.

verificationLimits: No compiled C# or game frame parity. Native Sequence/MultiMelee/ProjectileController unavailable; born-to-selector boundaries and Arts-before-Physical callback order are bounded local mappings.
S1 phase2 retains last phase1 marker under capped playback. Native Sequence interval shortening at high ASPD requires frame comparison.
S3 checks once per simulator tick after distance gate. Native per-frame collision and enemy collider radii not certified; extension follows eligible collider dispatch rather than damage amount.
S3 Unity moving projectile/disappear/return VFX not rendered: original chibi stays at deployment tile; combat collider moves independently.
Ordinary clip order is local round robin, not native replacement randomization.
Native status-duration floor covers supported Resist statuses; engine tick quantization and unsupported abnormal producers remain limits.
Enemy defensive SP not implemented for two supported basic enemy kits; Arts retains no-SP receipt metadata.
Modules, native particle/audio effects, other enemies and other stages remain unsupported.

notes: S1 third combo is tracked per victim and occupies two attack intervals.
S2 events are fixed independently of ASPD; its attack multiplier also scales talent Arts.
S2 rejects stun/freeze/sleep but takes damage.
S3 has invulnerability, no block and control immunity throughout the deployment skill; other abnormal duration floors to one thousandth.
S3 rush speed8, .51-tile collider, extends on hits up to5tiles and stops at board edge.
Talent Arts does not grant enemy defensive SP.
authoredGameplayNotes.role: Corroborating authored notes; original tables/graphs/animation events remain primary numeric evidence.
